story.i_want: a role-aware dashboard layout with intuitive navigation
story.so_that: I can quickly access the areas of the system relevant to my responsibilities

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Main layout includes top header, left sidebar navigation, and main content region wired into Quasar layout primitives.
Dashboard landing page renders placeholder widget slots for key modules (Upcoming Events, Quick Stats, Recent Activity).
Navigation menu items respect the user's permissions, showing only authorized modules based on RBAC utilities.
Header user menu displays the authenticated user's name and active role badges.
Layout is responsive for desktop (1920px), tablet (768px), and mobile (320px) breakpoints with consistent usability.
Sidebar collapses into a hamburger-triggered drawer on tablet/mobile screens.
Dashboard hero greets the user with "Welcome back, [User Name]".
Placeholder widgets display section headers and loading states for Upcoming Events, Quick Stats, and Recent Activity.
Dashboard initial render completes within 2 seconds on a simulated 3G connection by minimizing blocking requests and leveraging skeleton states.

docs.doc: Defines story goals, acceptance criteria, and prerequisite alignment for the dashboard shell.
Specifies 3G performance targets and responsive design requirements for low-end hardware.
Describes GraphQL aggregation strategy and client utilities (`useDashboardData`) that the dashboard shell must integrate with.
Outlines sidebar, bottom navigation, role-based visibility, and offline indicator placement expectations.
Captures RBAC utilities (`usePermissions`, `PermissionGuard.vue`) and navigation guard patterns to reuse.

code.file: Existing shell that will be expanded with RBAC-aware navigation, greeting banner, and responsive drawer behavior.
Provides permission helpers used to hide or show navigation items and header actions per user role.
Navigation guard enforcing `meta.requiresAuth` and `meta.requiresPermission`; dashboard routes should rely on these checks.
Current route definitions; dashboard routes will need RBAC metadata and new `/dashboard` view registration.
Temporary landing page illustrating layout bindings; will either evolve or redirect to the new Dashboard page.

node.package: Core framework for Composition API and `` usage.
State store backing user/session data consumed by navigation and greeting.
Routing system providing nested layout routes and navigation guards.
Backend SDK used for user details surfaced in the header (name, roles).
Utility for displaying time-based greetings or timestamps if needed in placeholder widgets.

interface.name: useDashboardData
interface.signature: function useDashboardData(): { loading, error, data, fetchVillageOverview, fetchFarmDashboard }

constraints.constraint: Vue components must use `` syntax and follow Quasar layout patterns. [docs/architecture.md#Section 9]
Navigation visibility must reuse RBAC utilities delivered in Story 1.4; no duplicate permission logic. [docs/stories/story-1.4.md#Dev Notes]
Dashboard data hydration should call consolidated GraphQL resolvers to avoid multiple REST calls. [docs/architecture.md#10.5-10.7]
Offline indicator and sync status must remain visible and unobstructed across breakpoints. [docs/ux-specification.md#Navigation States]
MVP testing relies on manual verification only; document results without introducing new automated suites. [docs/testing.md#Story 1.5: Dashboard Framework and Layout - MVP Testing Plan]

tests.standards: Automated testing is deferred for MVP. Developers must record manual verification outcomes covering navigation visibility, responsiveness across breakpoints, and 3G performance budget.
tests.locations: Manual verification notes stored in story completion log; no automated test directories required during MVP.

ideas.idea: Confirm different role logins show only authorized navigation modules in the sidebar.
Resize viewport (desktop, tablet, mobile) ensuring layout remains usable and content accessible.
On mobile, trigger hamburger menu via keyboard and touch to verify drawer accessibility.
Render placeholder widgets with loading state and ensure skeletons display while data hydrates.
Run Lighthouse with 3G profile and capture first-contentful-paint metrics within 2 seconds.
